products.product: Slavens Mule 250/300 Cylinder Kits for '23-26 KTM/HQV/GG TBI

fits.notes: Slavens listing 'Comp: 23-26 Husqvarna 250/300 TC/TX TBI (TC 300 is a 2025 roster model)' (https://slavensracing.com/shop/slavens-mule-250-300-cylinder-kits-for-ktm-hqv-gg-tbi/)

products.what_it_changes: Bolt-on 300 cylinder kit that turns a 250 TBI into a 300, or upgrades a 300. Slavens says it raises compression for more low-end and mid-range torque, runs on pump fuel, and does not shorten engine life. No horsepower figures are printed.
products.supporting_parts: Included: complete 300 cylinder, SX cylinder head (higher compression than stock 300), Vertex OEM piston kit, all power-valve parts, top-end gaskets and O-rings. On a 250, the ECU needs a 300 map: with a stock ECU, the dealer must reflash it to 300 maps. The page also lists the 'TSP ERM' (Two Stroke Performance ECU Reflash Module).
products.caveats: Turning a 250 into a 300 changes displacement, which matters for race classes. Slavens is both maker and store; no SKU is printed. Years are as printed (23-26 Comp / 24-26 Enduro).

gaps: Cannon Racecraft does no engine porting or head work. Its site and 2025 application chart cover only motorcycle/ATV fork and shock springs and custom springs, so it is recorded under suspension (four 'Fork springs / shock springs' records). Its chart has no Husqvarna, GasGas or Triumph sections.
Smart Performance: no motocross parts maker by this name was found. Searches returned only 'SMART', an Australian (Honda) rider-coaching program (fullnoise.com.au). Nothing in scope.
JE Racing / 'Jamie Ellis': no two-stroke porting business under that name could be confirmed, so it was left out (no invented entity).
Wilson Motorsports: no motocross two-stroke porting shop by this name was found (only Wilson Manifolds, automotive intake manifolds). Not included.
Eric Gorr Racing: ericgorr.com now shows a parked 'domain may be for sale' page. No current maker site was found, so there are no services, years or prices to record.

Bills Pipes: billspipes.com is now a WordPress site mixing a few legacy product titles (e.g. 'MX2 Works Pipe 02-19 YZ 250') with unrelated blog posts ('best MTB stem', 'straight pipe a truck'). It is not trustworthy as the maker's fitment source, and Bills Pipes makes exhausts (another slice), so it was not recorded. MXA tested a Bills MX2 pipe on a Husqvarna TC250 (motocrossactionmag.com/mxa-team-tested-bills-pipes-mx2-husqvarna-tc250), but year and part number were not verified.

Boyesen Rad Valve for 2020+ KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas: not shown on their vehicle pages. Only replacement reeds PSR-042 list KTM 250 SX 17-21 / Husqvarna TC250 17-21, and the valve's PN was not found. The YZ250 'Low End Torque' Rad Valve PN is only implied as RAD34T.
Moto Tassinari: no 2026-2027 fitment (the Parts Finder stops at 2025). The finder lookup for the 2020 KTM 150 XC-W TPI returned unfiltered results. No Honda/Kawasaki full-size two-strokes in range.

Slavens Racing also sells a 'Slavens Mule Power Valve Tuning Kit' and Two Stroke Performance (TSP) heads, piston kits, an oversized power-valve cover and an ECU Reflash Module for '23+ KTM TBI. The TSP parts are another maker's products sold by Slavens, and the tuning kit lists no years, so they are not recorded. The '19-22 Slavens Mule carbureted 300 kit' is marked 'FULL KIT NO LONGER AVAILABLE' and is left out.
No send-in porting service with explicit 2020-2027 bike lists was found from the named specialists. The only verified service is the Slavens Head Mod (300cc heads, 2020-2023).

Boyesen: only reed, intake, cover and Supercooler products were crawled for the two-stroke models (plus the shared KTM-family clutch cover). Boyesen also makes four-stroke covers and other parts for the roster that were not crawled.
Not crawled: Moto Tassinari VForce3 / 'Mini' lines, and Boyesen Works Edition billet covers (HardCoat Grey) and power-valve cover.
